name: Aeroderivative and industrial gas turbines
applications: offshore platform power and gas compression
principle: Gas turbines derived from jet engines (aeroderivatives) and light industrial frames in the 5 to 120 MW range. They start in minutes and suit peaking, islanded and mechanical-drive duty. Baker Hughes's LM6000PF+ makes 52.5 MWe at over 41% simple-cycle efficiency and reaches full power in 10 minutes or less; GE's LM2500XPRESS is a packaged 34 to 36 MW plant delivered as 10 modules.
